acquisition: Launch both public iq48 grant requests concurrently. One ordinary connection per named receiver only; nominal center, 120s (5,760,000 complex samples, 48,000 Hz) from first supplied IQ. Original 16-bit stereo samples plus original per-packet timestamp CSV, preserve partial delivered samples and receiver errors. No retry or alternate. Concurrent starting requests do not imply identical station clock starts.
selection: After reception ends and hashes are fixed, demodulate all available samples of each file from sample zero once only, unshifted and unpadded. If stream incomplete or any jumps, report status and retain its received samples. For the primary require a complete source (clocked, no measured jump exceeding one sample), and direct chronologically consecutive raw phase-0/1/2 native units of one group in Yokohama each with 4 physical CRCs, expected headers, DU CRC and byte equality to coordinate-assigned snapshot; earliest native phase-zero row in this file only. Even if no peer packets/DU/group, keep same primary. If no eligible primary or input report null. Report all coordinate intersections, gaps, conflicts and overlap bytes, peer full group if available. No combining signals or interpreting protected bytes; no secondary selection.
scope: One short independent experiment only. No new scheduled event or change to the existing 13:00 UTC Yokohama experiment.
